title: Evergreen Lighting Malaysia Website
projectHtml:

Their primary objective was to create a product catalog that allowed customers to explore their offerings, including indoor, outdoor, stage, decoration, customized light fittings, and sensor lights, catering to household, industrial, commercial, and designer industries. Additionally, the website needed a feature for customers to inquire about specific products directly.

Evergreen company required a website with:

  • A detailed catalog to showcase the wide variety of lighting products.
  • A responsive design that provides a smooth browsing experience across all devices.
  • An intuitive interface allowing users to easily navigate between product categories.
  • A user-friendly inquiry system for customers to reach out directly regarding specific products.
projectOutcome: Delivered a responsive lighting product catalogue with clear product categories, fast browsing, and product-specific enquiry paths for household, commercial, industrial, and design customers.
solutionHtml:
To meet client’s requirements, we structured the website with a clean, visually engaging layout that emphasized the versatility and quality of their lighting products. Our design team created a sleek interface that allowed users to browse various product categories effortlessly.

Once the design was finalized, our developers built the site with responsive technology to ensure consistent performance across devices. We also implemented a streamlined inquiry system that allows users to send product-related inquiries directly from the catalog pages. The website was optimized for performance, ensuring quick load times and a seamless experience for users, ultimately fulfilling the client’s need for a professional and functional online presence.
developerQuote: “The website is designed with a clean, responsive layout to highlight your lighting products, featuring fast load times and an integrated inquiry system for easy communication.”
